conventions.result_session: the results (board-meeting) date if it is a trading session, else the next session
conventions.window: cutoff = 2 sessions before the result session; Day-1, Result day, Day+1 = the sessions before, of and after the result session
conventions.three_day: Day-1 + Result day + Day+1 daily close-to-close returns (= cutoff close to Day+1 close), percent
conventions.reaction_day: Day+1 for results after the close on a trading day, else the Result day
conventions.winner: reaction-day return minus Nifty 50's return that day > +4%
conventions.lag: 21-session return minus Nifty 50's 21-session return, at the close
conventions.volume_ratio: mean volume of the last 5 sessions / mean of the last 60 (split / bonus adjusted)
conventions.growth: Sales / PAT growth in percent; PAT = profit attributable to owners (consolidated where filed; banks standalone); Sales = revenue from operations (banks: interest earned); blank when the base quarter was zero or a loss

research.label: TRADE (paper-trade)
research.finding: 21-session return minus Nifty's below -10% and 5/60 volume >= 1.0x at the cutoff close; buy at the cutoff close, sell at the Day+1 close: 85 trades, +2.13% (+1.96% after costs), 18 of 19 quarters with trades positive; 1.3x version 44 trades, +2.77%. Cut-offs chosen after looking; without the best 5 trades +1.36%. Realistic +1% to +1.5% a trade after costs.

research.label: TRADE (paper-trade)
research.finding: Reaction-day return beats Nifty by more than 4%: buy at the next open, hold 20 sessions against Nifty. All winners +1.45% a trade over Nifty (392 trades, 15 of 22 quarters); with RSI(14) > 50 at the cutoff +2.42% (232 trades, 17 of 22), +2.04% at the next open with 0.40% cost. Realistic about +1% over Nifty. Winners with RSI 50 or below: +0.04%, skip.

research.signal: Hold results winners 60 sessions instead of 20
research.label: WATCH
research.finding: +5.10% vs +1.85% on unseen quarters, but the same per day; not significant. About +2% per 60-session trade.

research.label: MARGINAL
research.finding: Buy the ATM straddle 5 sessions before the last close before the numbers, sell at that close, only if the front expiry is within 14 sessions: +0.065R in 2023-25; +2.2% a trade out of sample (556 trades), two of five seasons slightly negative. Needs fills near mid.

research.signal: Last-4 three-day average in the top tenth
research.label: WATCH
research.finding: Stocks that habitually rise into their results: 292 trades, +1.07% before costs (+0.90% after), found after the fact; five stocks give 60% of it. Realistic about +0.45% after costs.

research.signal: Auto and auto-parts stocks (cutoff close to Day+1 close)
research.label: WATCH
research.finding: +1.20% a result (264 results), above the quarter's average in 18 of 22 quarters; with NSE's auto sector +1.10%, resting on three stocks and on 2021-23 (adjusted p 0.06-0.23). Realistic well under +1%.

research.signal: A stock's earlier three-day moves -> direction of its next one
research.label: NOT PREDICTIVE
research.finding: Rank correlation with last quarter's move +0.005 (3,177 results); up after an up quarter 49%, after a down quarter 48%; no lag of 1-8 quarters and none of 84 pattern tests confirmed.

research.signal: Size of a stock's earlier three-day moves -> size of its next one
research.label: DESCRIPTIVE (options only)
research.finding: Persists a little (rank correlation about +0.05 with last quarter's absolute move), mostly because volatile stocks move more (60-day volatility alone +0.12). Says nothing about direction; no cash trade.

research.signal: Last result a winner / a loser
research.label: NOT PREDICTIVE
research.finding: Next three-day window -0.04% after a winner, +0.06% after a loser.

research.label: NOT PREDICTIVE (known only after the numbers)
research.finding: No fundamental screen before results works (44 screens within about +-0.3%); after results, strong numbers bought +0.52% over 20 sessions vs +0.43% for all results, and shorting bad numbers lost money. The per-stock 'after good / bad numbers' columns here are descriptive.

research.signal: Technical analysis, EMA / SMA at the cutoff
research.label: NOT PREDICTIVE
research.finding: 44 textbook signals and 59 EMA / SMA signals: none passes; the small negative EMA / SMA link is market timing and vanishes among results on the same day.

research.label: NOT PREDICTIVE
research.finding: No memory between seasons; buying last quarter's best sector made -0.24% a result.

research.signal: The average F&O stock in the three-day window
research.label: BASELINE
research.finding: +0.04% a result (-0.05% vs Nifty), a loss after 0.17% round-trip costs; no short works.
